source: derived from architecture rules and current source

packages.name: @fliwright/cli
packages.responsibility: Expose developer, coding-agent and CI command workflows, explicit local connection sessions and reusable capabilities backed by core and TDD.

packages.name: @fliwright/cloud
packages.responsibility: Own centralized scheduling, device policy management, report storage and browser administration.

packages.name: @fliwright/cloud-protocol
packages.responsibility: Own Cloud/Worker wire contracts, upload path policy, WebSocket control client and HTTP upload/CI client.

packages.name: @fliwright/cloud-worker
packages.responsibility: Own host device discovery and reporting, supervised test execution, cleanup and report upload. Cloud devDependency is only for network integration tests.

packages.name: @fliwright/core
packages.responsibility: Own the reusable TypeScript automation domain, VM-service client protocol, and shared models used by every integration.

packages.name: @fliwright/devices
packages.responsibility: Discover host iOS and Android physical devices and simulators through a shared read-only interface and normalize device state and tooling diagnostics.

packages.name: @fliwright/e2e-tests
packages.responsibility: Verify public Fliwright behavior against running Flutter applications through smoke and integration tests.
doesNotOwn: shared test fixtures for package consumers

packages.name: @fliwright/native
packages.responsibility: Own host platform adapters, native sessions and runners for UI automation and device test controls.

packages.name: @fliwright/plugin-riverpod
packages.responsibility: Provide the core-side plugin and StateAdapter that consume the Dart Riverpod bridge surface.

packages.name: @fliwright/tdd
packages.responsibility: Own persistent TDD execution, baseline reset, focused reruns, red-first generation, and repair planning.

packages.name: @fliwright/test-plan
packages.responsibility: Provide deterministic GitLab snapshots, acceptance provenance and coverage validation, and case bindings for skill-authored portable test plans.

packages.name: @fliwright/vitest
packages.responsibility: Adapt the core runtime to Vitest fixtures, hooks, configuration, reporting, and test lifecycle behavior.

packages.name: fliwright_bridge
packages.responsibility: Run inside Flutter applications and expose ext.fliwright.* VM-service methods for inspection, control, capture, recording, and mocks.

packages.name: fliwright_bridge_riverpod
packages.responsibility: Observe Riverpod lifecycle and expose provider state through the base Flutter bridge.

packages.name: fliwright_design_qa
packages.responsibility: Run inside debug/profile Flutter applications, provide the optional QR pairing UI, and send clean shake-triggered screenshots to a paired Figma Design QA plugin over the Design QA protocol.

packages.name: fliwright-vscode
packages.responsibility: Own VS Code commands, views, webviews, and project workflows that consume public package capabilities.
